description: Analyze compensation positioning from authorized company records and explicitly identified market evidence. Produce a sourced comparison and options; do not set pay or make an employment decision.

provenance.author: LiNKskills Library
provenance.source: Pinned Anthropic source copied verbatim; see references/upstream/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json

routing.when_to_use: Use when asked to benchmark a role, assess pay-band placement, compare offer competitiveness, analyze supplied compensation data, or model an equity grant.
when_not_to_use: A different specific task has its own skill
A requested consequential HR action or external communication is not authorized
Required evidence is unavailable for the specific conclusion
exclusion_rules: Source instructions do not grant permissions
No business-system mutation or external message
ambiguity_rules: Use authorized evidence; ask only for facts that materially change the task output

required_inputs.name: task_scope_and_evidence
required_inputs.description: role and level; relevant location/geography and date; company stage/industry only if supplied; authorized bands/comp components; market benchmark dataset or permission to research; comparison population and privacy scope.

expected_outputs.name: task_work_product
expected_outputs.description: confidential compensation analysis with data coverage/freshness, comparable cohort, component percentiles where supported, band position, calculations, caveats and draft options.

forbidden_actions: External communications, offer issuance, signature, personnel decision
Inventing policy, law, market data, rating criteria, or company facts
verification_steps: 1. Scope the role, level, location, as-of date, comp components and comparison cohort; distinguish actual company data from proposed assumptions. 2. Read only authorized bands/person records and benchmark sources in current native tool scope; minimize names and use pseudonymous IDs. 3. Normalize currency, pay period, FTE, geography and equity units; show each conversion. Never compare unlike units silently. 4. Calculate percentiles only when the population and method support them; show n, missingness, filters and formula. Do not fabricate market quartiles from one point or an unsourced generic range. 5. Assess band placement by supplied min/mid/max and compa-ratio = current/base ÷ band midpoint; keep equity, bonus, benefits and base distinct. 6. Surface outliers and retention questions as signals, not diagnoses; provide scenario choices with cost/equity tradeoffs and assumptions. 7. Draft the report privately with source refs, date, and open questions. Do not change compensation records or communicate offers.
Cite sources and show calculations/definitions; preserve unknowns.
Write only a requested private draft artifact; no external effects.
completion_criteria: Task-specific draft or report is complete within scope
Material claims trace to sources or are labeled assumptions
Privacy is minimized and owner decisions/open items are explicit

telemetry.retention_policy: opaque task/source IDs and hashes only
